summary: Executable Custom Action that delegates image generation to the signed-in Codex built-in image generation tool.
context_hints: Keep Codex CLI execution in the Clash host capability; the sandboxed plugin may only request codex.image.generate through the broker
Do not add API-key fallbacks: this Action intentionally uses the user's existing Codex sign-in
Keep generated bytes project-scoped by returning an asset handle from the host broker

subdirectories.cards: User-facing Action Card parameters and reference-image constraints.
subdirectories.src: Sandboxed stdio adapter and protocol tests.
subdirectories.dist: Generated standalone install artifact; never hand-edit.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package, exports, and least-privilege host capability declaration.
key_files.cards/codex-imagegen.json: Marketplace Action Card and aspect-ratio controls.
